hero-headline.purpose: App-header hero line, e.g. "Find your next favourite bite."

shadows.name: anchor
shadows.purpose: Persistent page anchor, e.g. featured card.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Dialog/modal and FAB popover, strongest shadow in the system.

shadows.name: fab
shadows.purpose: FAB and active bottom-nav bump, terracotta-tinted glow.

shadows.name: floating-image
shadows.purpose: Floating product photo breaking a card edge (featured/promo cards).

motion.name: pill-active
motion.value: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button; forest-green, reserved for the splash screen and primary actions off the main interface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1c5a45; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 18px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #174840; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ed9e57; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pill White Button
components.description: CTA on featured/promo gradient cards — white pill so it reads over a dark or warm background.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill-white { background: #ffffff; color: #18332f; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 22px; font-weight: 800; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 850; } .ds-status-pill--open { background: #e9f4e9; color: #287848; } .ds-status-pill--upcoming { background: #fff3df; color: #a15c2d; } .ds-status-pill--closed { background: #f1f0ea; color: #69756c; } .ds-status-pill--sold-out { background: #f5f0f0; color: #8a3a2d; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Square-photo product card with terracotta price and batch-time caption; hover lift.
components.css: .ds-product-card { display: block; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e9de; border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-product-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 12px 25px #173a2e13; } .ds-product-card-img { aspect-ratio: 1/1; border-radius: 12px; background: #f1f0ea; } .ds-product-card-price { color: #d97c40; font-weight: 800; } .ds-product-card-batch { color: #7a8c83; font-size: .78rem; }

components.name: Featured Market Card
components.description: Forest-gradient anchor card with a floating photo breaking the card edge, status + distance, white pill CTA.
components.html:
Tonight only

Taman Jaya Night Market
components.css: .ds-featured-card { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #17443e 0%, #1c5a45 100%); border-radius: 28px; padding: 24px; min-height: 220px; } .ds-featured-card-eyebrow { color: #f5be73; font-weight: 850; font-size: .72rem; } .ds-featured-card-headline { color: #fff; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.5rem; }

components.name: Promo Card (warm)
components.description: Gold-to-terracotta gradient promo card, floating product image, white pill CTA labelled "See Offer".
components.html: 30% off closing batches
components.css: .ds-promo-card-warm { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5be73 0%, #d97c40 100%); border-radius: 22px; padding: 20px; color: #18332f; } .ds-promo-card-warm h3 { font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.3rem; }

components.name: Promo Card (dark)
components.description: Near-black promo card with an ambient gold glow behind the product image; bold terracotta percentage in the CTA.
components.css: .ds-promo-card-dark { background: #18332f; border-radius: 22px; padding: 20px; } .ds-promo-card-dark-eyebrow { color: #ffffffaa; font-size: .8rem; } .ds-promo-card-dark h3 { color: #fff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.3rem; } .ds-promo-card-dark-bold { color: #d97c40; }

components.name: Category Card
components.description: Horizontal icon+text category card, 2-column grid, flat at rest.
components.css: .ds-category-card { display: flex; gap: 12px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e9de; border-radius: 18px; padding: 16px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: transform 220ms ease, box-shadow 220ms ease; } .ds-category-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 12px 25px #173a2e13; } .ds-category-card-icon { width: 35%; border-radius: 14px; background: #f1f0ea; } .ds-category-card h4 { color: #18332f; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.18rem; } .ds-category-card p { color: #7a8c83; font-size: .85rem; }

components.name: Segmented Tab
components.description: Popular/Nearby segmented control, terracotta active fill on a cream track.
components.css: .ds-segmented-tab { display: inline-flex; background: #f1f0ea; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px; } .ds-segmented-tab-item { border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #18332f; background: transparent; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-segmented-tab-item--active { background: #d97c40; color: #fff; font-weight: 800; }

components.name: Search Bar
components.description: Floating pill search field under the app-header hero.
components.css: .ds-search-bar { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e9e9dd; border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 48px; box-shadow: 0 13px 30px #2047341a; } .ds-search-bar input { border: 0; width: 100%; color: #18332f; } .ds-search-bar input::placeholder { color: #7a8c83; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid #deded6; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #fff; color: #18332f; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ed9e57; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-input--error { border: 1px solid #c0392b; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Floating white pill bottom bar, raised terracotta bump with scalloped notch for the active item.
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { display: flex; background: #fff; border-radius: 999px; height: 64px; margin: 0 20px 16px; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px #18332f22; } .ds-bottom-nav-item { color: #7a8c83; } .ds-bottom-nav-item--active { background: #d97c40; color: #fff; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 999px; transform: translateY(-16px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px #d97c4055; }

components.name: FAB
components.description: Hawker-side floating action button, expands to an Add food / New batch / More popover.
components.css: .ds-fab { position: fixed; right: 20px; bottom: 90px; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 999px; background: #d97c40; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px #d97c4055; }

components.name: Freshness Ring
components.description: Circular countdown ring on batches; stroke color and pulse speed escalate from fresh to expired.
components.html: <svg class="ds-freshness-ring ds-freshness-ring--fresh" width="56" height="56"><circle class="ds-freshness-ring-track" /><circle class="ds-freshness-ring-progress" /></svg>
components.css: .ds-freshness-ring-track { stroke: #e9e9dd; stroke-width: 5px; fill: none; } .ds-freshness-ring--fresh .ds-freshness-ring-progress { stroke: #287848; animation: ds-ring-pulse 2400ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1) infinite; } .ds-freshness-ring--warning .ds-freshness-ring-progress { stroke: #a15c2d; animation: ds-ring-pulse 1600ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1) infinite; } .ds-freshness-ring--urgent .ds-freshness-ring-progress { stroke: #d97c40; animation: ds-ring-pulse 900ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1) infinite; } .ds-freshness-ring--expired .ds-freshness-ring-progress { stroke: #69756c; animation: none; }

components.name: Voice Record Button
components.description: Voice-to-draft entry button; idle/recording/processing/done states, red pulsing ring while recording.
components.css: .ds-voice-btn { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-voice-btn--idle { background: #1c5a45; color: #fff; } .ds-voice-btn--recording { background: #e74c3c; animation: ds-ring-pulse 900ms ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-voice-btn--processing { background: #17443e; color: #f5be73; animation: spin 800ms linear infinite; } .ds-voice-btn--done { background: #287848; }

narrative.overview: PasarMalam's main interface reads as a night market stall glimpsed at dusk, but the metaphor now lives mostly in accents rather than in a wrapped canopy header. The header and content zone sit on a light, warm cream base (#f8f7f2) — never stark white — with forest-green reserved for the hero splash screen and primary buttons. Warm terracotta has grown into the app's primary interactive accent: it marks prices, active tabs, the active bottom-nav bump, the FAB, urgency badges, and the 'Malam' half of the wordmark. Gold/lantern accents stay rarer, used for the brand moon icon and featured-card eyebrows. The system stays warm and earthy rather than corporate: pill shapes for anything selectable, flat cards that lift only on hover, and large (44-48px) touch targets throughout for stall-side, one-handed use. Freshness rings and a four-state voice-recording control give the deterministic-advisory and voice-draft-entry features their own honest, non-decorative visual language. No stock-photo gloss; missing photography uses the labelled placeholder pattern.
keyCharacteristics: Light, white/cream app header — the forest-green canopy no longer wraps it; green is reserved for the hero splash and primary CTA buttons
Warm terracotta as the primary interactive accent across the main interface — prices, active tab, active nav bump, FAB, urgency badges
Soft cream base (#f8f7f2), never stark white, for a warmer 'market floor' feel
Pill shapes everywhere interaction happens (segmented tabs, search bar, filter/sort pills, status pills, bottom nav, buttons)
Flat-by-default cards; depth appears only on hover, focus, modal, or fixed-anchor position
Freshness ring and voice-recording states are drawn from the product's real deterministic-advisory and voice-draft-entry features, not generic decoration

rules.name: The One Lantern Rule
rules.body: Gold stays rare — the brand moon icon and featured-card eyebrow only. Terracotta is the interactive accent for the main interface: prices, active/selected states, links, badges, the FAB. Neither ever becomes a background fill for large surfaces; large surfaces stay green (splash, primary buttons) or cream.

rules.name: The Weight-Over-Width Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from font-weight and negative tracking on headings, not from switching typefaces. Inter only.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels are flat at rest; a shadow only appears as a response to hover, focus, elevation (dialogs/FAB popover), or fixed anchor position (search bar, featured card) — never as resting decoration.

rules.name: The Pill-For-Choice Rule
rules.body: Any control representing a selectable state — segmented tab, status pill, filter/sort pill, bottom-nav item, button — is pill-shaped. Rectangular radii are reserved for containers that hold content (cards, panels).

rules.name: The Honest-Placeholder Rule
rules.body: Never fake missing food photography with stock imagery or gradients; use the labelled ImagePlaceholder pattern so the gap is visible rather than disguised.

dos: Do treat warm-terracotta as the interactive accent for the main interface — prices, active states, links, badges, FAB.
Do keep forest-green for the hero splash and primary buttons only.
Do keep the app header white/cream — the canopy green no longer wraps it.
Do use the floating pill bottom nav with a raised active bump, not a flat full-width bar.
Do keep cards flat at rest, shadow only on hover/focus/modal.
Do keep touch targets at a 44-48px minimum everywhere.
donts: Don't reintroduce the dark canopy header or wavy divider from v2 — superseded by the light header.
Don't use circular category pills — category cards are horizontal icon+text now.
Don't let forest-green compete with terracotta as an accent in the main interface — terracotta owns active/selected/price.
Don't fake food photos — use the labelled ImagePlaceholder pattern.
Don't invent a value not present in DESIGN.md — stop and ask.
